text: The six-day logging gap since September 19th is blocking my directional read, but today's log tells a clear story: 182g protein, 1,761 kcal, with the steak dinner anchoring 106g in a single sitting. The meal architecture is working when dinner shows up. Before the glucose coach's CGM data matures, I'm placing a guardrail: any carb reduction has to be calorie-neutral, not a straight cut. He's running a deep deficit at 1,596 kcal EWMA against a 2,362 kcal Mifflin BMR, and his recovery on the night of 2026-09-24 was 99% — that's not a number to gamble with by under-fueling. One flag: fiber came in at 16.7g, below baseline. With Zone 2 training starting next week, I've asked him to add a vegetable serving at lunch and restart logging tomorrow.
